sources.title: Gertrude01/3Class-Gel-Segmentation-Mar-2026 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This SMP-UNet model was trained on a subset of the GelGenie training dataset (144 images). It builds upon the GelGenie-Universal-Dec-2023 model, extending it from 2-class to 3-class segmentation (background, bands, and wells).
